description: Official-source metadata adapters for plant expression candidate ingestion. Records are candidates for manual documentation review, not approved catalog entries.

sources.endpoint_note: REST search endpoint using JSON metadata responses and cursorMark pagination.
sources.license_note: Metadata and abstracts are retained only as provided by Europe PMC API responses; full text is not downloaded by this adapter.
sources.usage_policy_note: Uses conservative page sizes, timeouts, retries, and pacing. No authentication or scraping.

sources.endpoint_note: UniProtKB REST search endpoint using JSON metadata responses and cursor pagination.
sources.license_note: Protein/accession metadata is retained as source metadata; no sequence bulk corpus is committed to Git.
sources.usage_policy_note: Uses conservative page sizes, timeouts, retries, and pacing. Optional API credentials are not required by this adapter.

deferred_sources.reason: Deferred from Batch 1 to keep the first foundation bounded after Europe PMC and UniProt are implemented. A future adapter can add E-utilities with explicit email/tool configuration and NCBI pacing rules.
Deferred because this batch avoids website scraping and uses only supported public APIs or download mechanisms.
